raw:
@q query
  select ?p
  where all
    match
      relation "be cheaper for"
      role subject ?c
      role object "sending parcels from Dublin to Craiova"
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "be"
      role subject ?c
      role object ?v
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?v equal "Nobel Transport", then end
  compare ?v equal "DPD", then end
